text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Here it is, the long-awaited Arima Kinen! And out of all the Umamusume chosen to participate, the one making headlines is…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The Beast, Grass Wonder! Everyone is on the edge of their seats, eagerly awaiting her clash with her biggest rival, Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Calm. And very much so. You could say I've found my comfort zone.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to the moment when the starting gate opens.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm both grateful and honored to share the racecourse with such worthy competitors.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But most importantly, I will press forward.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win… This is my race!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let's give this race our all!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: You two look excited. Don't get too down on yourselves when I turn out the winner.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: For me, losin' here ain't an option. Comprenden?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Here it is: the fanfare of the Arima Kinen!
